objective: check whether C15 source-only NVTX intervals can be built and collected without a model run
hypothesis: the optional C15 intervals can expose per-thread CPU MMID, expert pread and upload intervals in a local process-tree trace; exclusive critical-path time still requires a separately frozen physical test
alternative: the patch fails to build/collect, or the intervals are insufficient to attribute removable exclusive prefill time
trace_policy: model-free tiny NVTX smoke only; raw profiler output local, hashed and not committed
claim_limit: build/smoke cannot show interval coverage, exclusive prefill fraction, causal speedup or 120B numerical fidelity
failure_policy: preserve FAIL; next debug has new identity
